mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CATEGORIES (CATEGORY_ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, DISPLAY_ORDER, ENABLED, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{displayOrder}, #{enabled}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE CATEGORIES SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
UPDATE CATEGORIES SET enabled = FALSE, updated_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, DISPLAY_ORDER, ENABLED, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE FROM CATEGORIES WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} AND ENABLED = TRUE

SELECT CATEGORY_ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, DISPLAY_ORDER, ENABLED, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE FROM CATEGORIES WHERE ENABLED = TRUE ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, CREATED_DATE DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CATEGORIES WHERE enabled = TRUE
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CATEGORIES WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{name}))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CATEGORIES WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{name}) AND category_id != #{categoryId})
